source_name: Central Banking — Montenegro region page
why_relevant: Specialist central-banking trade press with a Montenegro region tag and a CBCG institution page; covers governance, governor appointments and supervisory-policy shifts from a practitioner angle.

source_name: Regional republication layer (raport.ba, capital.ba, poslovni-dnevnik.me)
why_relevant: Bosnian/regional business portals republished the CBCG five-bank AML fines story, sometimes with different framing or retained detail. Useful as a redundancy channel when a Montenegrin original is removed, edited or paywalled.

source_name: CBCG – Zapošljavanje (Central Bank of Montenegro employment page)
why_relevant: The supervisor's own hiring page. It states CBCG advertises everything from pripravnik to managerial posts and names the exact publication channels (zzzcg.me, print, cbcg.me, prekoveze.me, CBCG social accounts) and the application mailbox posao@cbcg.me. Job titles for supervizija banaka, platni promet, sprječavanje pranja novca and instant-payments/TIPS Clone project roles are the earliest observable signal of which supervisory workstreams CBCG is staffing up for.

source_name: ZZZCG – Oglasi za slobodna radna mjesta (Montenegro Employment Agency vacancy register)
why_relevant: The statutory national vacancy register: every employer, including CBCG and commercial banks, publishes here (adverts also run in daily 'Dan' Mon/Wed/Fri). Individual adverts sit at stable per-ID URLs (e.g. /oglas/<id>/), which makes it the single highest-yield structured feed for detecting banks hiring compliance officers, AML ovlašćena lica, payment-system engineers or instant-payments project managers.

source_name: Prekoveze.me – Bankarstvo job category
why_relevant: Commercial Montenegrin HR portal with a dedicated banking category; CBCG names it as one of its own advertising channels, and CKB and Adriatic Bank adverts were observed in the category. Sector-scoped listing means low noise for weak-signal hiring monitoring.

source_name: Uprava za kadrove / Uprava za ljudske resurse – Pregled oglasa (public-administration vacancies)
why_relevant: Central register of javni konkurs / javni oglas / interni oglas for state bodies. Captures hiring at the Ministarstvo finansija and the FIU (Uprava za sprječavanje pranja novca i finansiranja terorizma) — staffing there is a leading indicator of AML/CFT and MONEYVAL-driven workload and of transposition work on payments legislation.

source_name: Bankar.me – Konferencije / Edukacija category
why_relevant: The Montenegrin banking trade portal aggregates both conference announcements/agendas and bank recruitment adverts (it republished CBCG and Prva banka vacancy notices and CBCG's instant-payments workshop). Best single pointer for discovering events and hiring rounds that never appear on institutional sites.

source_name: CBCG – Instant plaćanja (TIPS Clone) programme page and associated workshops
why_relevant: The TIPS Clone go-live (reported as 20 July 2026) is the anchor deadline that drives both the training/workshop calendar and the recruitment wave. CBCG ran a two-day regional workshop with the World Bank and European Commission on AML/CFT and anti-fraud duties of banks under real-time payments — workshop agendas of this kind pre-announce supervisory expectations before any rulebook appears.

source_name: Adria Future Summit (Tivat / Porto Montenegro; successor to ESG Adria Summit)
why_relevant: The 2026 edition (22-24 April, Tivat) put three central bank governors — including CBCG Governor Irena Radović — on one stage to debate digital euro design, CBDC frameworks and payment infrastructure. Panel titles and speaker lists at this level are direct evidence of which payment agendas Montenegro's regulator is preparing to act on.

source_name: "Montenegro Financial Markets" international conference (Komisija za tržište kapitala / SCMN)
why_relevant: Co-organised by the Capital Market Commission, the Insurance Supervision Agency, the Ministry of Finance and CBCG. The 2023 edition already carried a dedicated panel on SEE integration into SEPA — i.e. the conference agenda flagged the SEPA workstream years before Montenegro's actual SEPA accession. Panel titles are a reliable forward indicator of the supervisory agenda.

source_name: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (UBCG) – Association of Banks of Montenegro
why_relevant: All 11 licensed banks are members; UBCG is an associate member of the EBF, full member of IFBA and member of MBS. It is the natural convener of sector working groups, member briefings and training on new payment/compliance rules, and its calendar reveals which rule banks are collectively preparing for. Also a pointer to the full member/actor list.

source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore – Odbor udruženja bankarstva, drugih finansijskih organizacija i osiguranja
why_relevant: The Chamber's banking board convenes bank representatives on regulatory topics and publishes its membership (president Miloš Miketić, Lovćen banka; secretary Almer Bećiragić). Board session agendas and Chamber announcements are an early, semi-formal channel for consultations and forthcoming obligations, and the membership list is a ready-made actor map.

source_name: Center for Finance Academy (CFA) via Privredna komora – accredited 'Ovlašćeno lice za sprečavanje pranja novca i finansiranja terorizma' qualification
why_relevant: A Ministry-of-Education-licensed second-qualification programme producing licensed AML compliance officers. Enrolment cycles, syllabus updates and the stated obligor list (banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, exchange offices, factoring) track changes in the AML/CFT licensing regime — a certification syllabus changes when the law is about to.

source_name: Institut internih revizora Crne Gore (IIRCG) – compliance and AML certification/webinars
why_relevant: Runs the 'Ovlašćeni ekspert za praćenje usklađenosti poslovanja' (certified compliance-monitoring expert) certification and AML/CFT webinars aimed at bank second- and third-line functions. New modules and webinar topics appear when banks anticipate a supervisory demand — a cheap, early proxy for compliance workload.

source_name: Edukativni centar (ME) – 'Ekspert prevencije i sprečavanja prevarnih radnji' fraud-prevention certification
why_relevant: A local fraud-prevention certification. Demand for anti-fraud certification in Montenegro rises directly with instant-payments go-live (CBCG's own workshop paired AML with anti-fraud duties), so enrolment/marketing of this programme is a weak signal on real-time payment fraud rules.

source_name: CKB (Crnogorska komercijalna banka, OTP Group) – TalentLyft careers portal
why_relevant: The largest bank in Montenegro by loans and deposits runs its recruitment through a structured ATS, so vacancy titles are machine-readable. Titles such as project manager for payments, digital channels, or compliance officer at the market leader are the earliest observable commitment to an implementation programme.

source_name: Prva banka Crne Gore – Karijera page
why_relevant: Bank-run vacancy page; observed adverts reference duties under the Law on Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism, i.e. the advert text itself names the governing statute and the function being staffed. Small-bank hiring is a good tell for whether compliance burden is spreading beyond the top tier.

source_name: LinkedIn – Jobs in Podgorica / Montenegro
why_relevant: Montenegro's banks post English-titled specialist roles here that never reach zzzcg.me — 'instant payments project manager', 'PSD2 compliance officer', 'core banking migration lead'. Around 200 Podgorica listings at any time, so keyword filtering is feasible. Note English-in-local usage: Montenegrin banks routinely advertise these roles under English titles.

source_name: Spark.me conference (Domain.ME, Montenegro)
why_relevant: Long-running curated business/internet conference held annually in Montenegro since 2013. Not banking-specific, but fintech/payments speakers and panel topics appearing on a domestic stage signal which technologies local institutions are courting. Useful as an actor-discovery surface for Montenegrin fintech.

source_name: Aktuelno.me / CdM / Portal Analitika – economic desks covering CBCG workshops and payment deadlines
why_relevant: Montenegrin economic news desks are frequently the only public record of a CBCG workshop's content, attendee set and stated purpose (e.g. the World Bank/EC-supported regional AML and anti-fraud workshop tied to TIPS Clone). They also carry go-live dates and fee caps before they surface in the Official Gazette.

source_name: ZZZCG – Obavještenja o objavljivanju oglasa (publication-rules notices)
why_relevant: Meta-source describing HOW and WHEN vacancies are published (Mon/Wed/Fri in daily 'Dan' plus the website, per the 2 Dec 2024 notice). Essential for calibrating a collector's polling schedule and for knowing when a print-only advert may exist that the website mirrors.

source_name: Facebook group 'OGLASI ZA POSAO CRNA GORA'
why_relevant: Informal aggregation of Montenegrin vacancy adverts, including bank posts, sometimes ahead of or instead of formal channels. Low reliability but occasionally captures adverts that are never web-published elsewhere.

source_name: Posao.crna.gora.me – Montenegrin job-advert portal
why_relevant: Additional commercial vacancy aggregator for Montenegro, useful as a redundancy layer against zzzcg.me and prekoveze.me so that a bank advert is not missed when an employer uses only one channel.

source_name: CBCG — Registar platnih institucija i njihovih agenata
why_relevant: Official register of authorised payment institutions plus their agents and branches — the core PSP actor list for the payments sector, including distribution networks that other cells cannot see.

source_name: CBCG — Registar institucija za elektronski novac i njihovih agenata / Register of E-money Institutions
why_relevant: Register of authorised e-money issuers, their branches and agents. English mirror exists, allowing cross-language name normalisation of the same entities.

source_name: CBCG — Spisak platnih institucija i institucija za elektronski novac kojima je oduzeto odobrenje
why_relevant: Negative register: authorisations withdrawn. This is the only official trail of enforcement/exit events for PSPs and EMIs and is a strong early-warning signal on supervisory action.

source_name: CBCG — Registar platnih sistema
why_relevant: Lists designated payment systems operating in Montenegro under the Law on Payment Transactions — infrastructure-level actor map (RTGS/DNS operators, card schemes if designated).
